StudioPage.label: M2B STUDIO
StudioPage.supporting: M2B is an independent technology innovation studio. We operate at the intersection of sovereign infrastructure, enterprise operations, and community culture.

philosophy.title: A studio built on rigor, not buzzwords.
philosophy.p1: In developing markets, software often breaks at the seams: when a field inspector enters a mountain valley with no cellular reception, when parents wait for critical student SMS transcripts, or when a telecommunications ministry needs an auditable record of spectrum rights.
philosophy.p2: M2B was founded to establish a gold standard of local craftsmanship. We don't rebrand cookie-cutter WordPress templates. We architect tailored solutions using industry-proven stacks — Laravel, Filament, Flutter, .NET, Next.js, and PostGIS — built to withstand decades of operational expansion.

principles.one: Zero offshore subcontracting — 100% in-house engineering and oversight.
principles.two: Deep partnerships with ministries, enterprises, and operators worldwide.
principles.three: Connecting engineering talent with global delivery networks.

nameOrigin.label: THE NAME
nameOrigin.title: Three surnames. One mark.
nameOrigin.verse: Not a slogan. Not a stack acronym. A quiet joining of three family names — pressed into a cipher the world can speak in a breath.
nameOrigin.closing: M from Mire. Two B’s from Bulbul and Bille. Written as one — M2B — so every system we ship still carries the people who built it.

mire.line: The first letter — the opening note of the mark.

bulbul.line: One of two B’s — twin pillars in the cipher.

bille.line: The second B — completing the 2B that follows M.

local.label: THE LOCAL REALITY BENCHMARK
local.title: We speak the local stack fluently.
local.supporting: Western frameworks assume fiber optics, credit cards, English UI, and Monday-to-Friday schedules. M2B designs from first principles for real-world constraints:

money.title: ZAAD & eDahab Mobile Money
money.body: Direct merchant API integrations, automated reconciliation, and dual USD/SLS currency pricing.

typography.title: Somali & Arabic Typography
typography.body: Somali labels are 20-35% longer than English. We design dynamic layouts that never clip or hyphenate awkwardly.

offline.title: Zero-Cellular Field Resilience
offline.body: Offline SQLite synchronization for inspectors auditing telecom towers or cleaning supervisors in basement parking.

calendar.title: Saturday–Wednesday Cycles
calendar.body: Academic calendars and governmental shifts natively follow regional workweeks without messy calendar hacks.
